策略地圖：頂點 → 兩條高 → 三邊及面積 → 內切半徑 → 切線長定位內心 → 點圓距離。
(a)
\[
f(x)=(x-k)^2+k,
\]
故
\[
Q=(k,k),\;\; R=(15k,k).
\]
\(x_H=6k\)。\(QS\) 的斜率為
\[
\frac{12k}{5k}=\frac{12}{5},
\]
所以從 \(R\) 作出的高線為
\[
y-k=-\frac{5}{12}(x-15k).
\]
代入 \(x=6k\)：
\[
y-k=\frac{15k}{4},
\]
故
\[
H=\left(6k,\frac{19k}{4}\right).
\]
(c)(i)
\[
QR=14k,\; QS=13k,\; RS=15k,
\]
而
\[
\Delta=\frac{1}{2}(14k)(12k)=84k^2,
\;\; s=21k.
\]
因此
\[
r=\frac\Delta s=4k.
\]
內切圓與水平邊 \(QR:y=k\) 相切，所以 \(y_U=k+r=5k\)。由 \(Q\) 出發在 \(QR\) 上的切線長為
\[
\frac{QR+QS-RS}{2}=\frac{14k+13k-15k}{2}=6k.
\]
故 \(x_U=k+6k=7k\)，所以
\[
U=(7k,5k).
\]
(iii)
\[
HU=\sqrt{(7k-6k)^2+\left(5k-\frac{19k}{4}\right)^2}
=\frac{\sqrt{17}}{4}k.
\]
因 \(HU<r=4k\)，H 在內切圓內，所以最短距離為
\[
r-HU=4k-\frac{\sqrt{17}}4k
=\frac{(16-\sqrt{17})k}{4}.
\]
陰濕位：點在圓內時最短距離是 \(r-HU\)，不是 \(HU-r\) 或 \(HU+r\)。

QS has slope 12/5, so the altitude through R is \(y-k=-5(x-15k)/12\). Thus \(H=(6k,19k/4)\). (c) The sides are \(13k,14k,15k\), with area \(84k^2\) and semiperimeter \(21k\), so \(r=4k\). The contact length from Q along QR is \((14k+13k-15k)/2=6k\), giving \(U=(7k,5k)\). Hence \(HU=\sqrt{17}k/4<4k\). The minimum distance is \(r-HU=(16-\sqrt{17})k/4\).

The larger hemisphere volume is \(\frac23\pi(30)^3=18000\pi\text{ cm}^3\). (b) Original total area is \(4\pi[25\sqrt{25^2+28^2}+25^2]=(2500+100\sqrt{1409})\pi\). Final total area, including both flat bases, is \(3\pi(20^2+30^2)=3900\pi\). The change is \(100[3900/(2500+100\sqrt{1409})-1]\approx-37.64\%\), a decrease.
